# Doss Realty

> Doss Realty (Doss Developers Pvt Ltd) is a Chennai-based real estate developer, building RERA-approved plotted communities and residential developments across Tamil Nadu since 1991. Founder & Chairman: D.V. Prathap Reddy. Over 5 million sq. ft. delivered across 15+ developments.

Doss Realty designs and delivers "Artistic Engineering" led developments — plotted communities and residences where design and engineering are planned together. Headquartered at 14, Prathap Palace, Porur-Kundrathur Main Road, Kovur, Chennai-600128, Tamil Nadu, India.

## Company

- [About Doss Realty](https://dossrealty.in/about): Company history, leadership (D.V. Prathap Reddy — Founder & Chairman; Varun V.P. and Guru V.P. — Directors), and philosophy.
- [Contact](https://dossrealty.in/contact): Phone +91 99629 96977, email info@dossrealty.in, office address, and site-visit scheduling.

## Projects

- [Metropettai](https://dossrealty.in/projects/metropettai): CMDA & RERA-approved (RERA TN/01/Reg-Layout/0995/2023) plotted community in Nazarethpettai, Poonamallee, West Chennai. Plots 711–2,400 sq. ft., from ₹45L onwards, 270 units, near the upcoming Metro corridor and Chennai–Bengaluru Highway.
- [Promise Park](https://dossrealty.in/projects/promise-park): DTCP & RERA-approved (RERA TN/01/Layout/1680/2023) plotted community near White Gate, Kanchipuram, off the Kanchi–Arakkonam Highway. Plots 443–2,348 sq. ft., from ₹15L onwards, 99 units.
